decisions.reason: Finds the disabled expression in AttachmentChips and shows that busy is declared only in the sibling AttachButton. Explains that an empty dock returns null before the map, and that a present occurrence in plain phase makes the guard false and throws a ReferenceError.
Explains that the render throw is caught by the slot error boundary, which unmounts the whole dock entry. The attach button survives in its own slot, and the error appears only in the console.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 line to show busy predates the diff. Notes the diff is inconsistent with that baseline and that imageItem reads record/status before they are declared. Proposes a rollback/re-add bisect and a data-present plain-phase mount with clear discriminators.

Removes busy and keeps the phase guard, or asks for properly owned state. Moves imageItem into the per-occurrence scope and adds record?.items ?? [] and closest?.(), explaining why these are cheap insurance in slots.

Proposes a mount test with one plain-phase occurrence that asserts the chip and remove button exist and the boundary captures nothing. Explains why an empty-state test misses the line and why node --check cannot catch unbound identifiers, and makes the render smoke part of the pre-ship gate.
